cases.name: Deborah "Debbie" Giles Clark
cases.narrative: On 4/4/1988, her remains were found near the Dallas branch of the Santa Fe tracks just east of Cleburne. She had suffered multiple stab wounds, a fractured skull and numerous abrasions.
